title: Via Senato
description: Former stretch of the Naviglio canal. Until the 1930s, water flowed here in the open beneath the noble palaces.

title: Laghetto di San Marco
description: Ancient port basin where the Naviglio Martesana ended. It was the commercial heart of the area, where boats stopped to unload goods and food supplies for the city markets.

title: Laghetto di Santo Stefano
description: The marble port. The blocks used to build Milan Cathedral arrived here.
